profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft
profile.summary: I am growing my skill set as a junior software engineer and game programmer to pursue a career in the tech industry. The languages I am currently learning are JavaScript, Python, C#, C++ and C. I am proficient at HTML and CSS. Code Nation, Gameheads, LaunchDarkly, and Microsoft has fostered growth in tech skill sets.

positions.title: Student Web Developer
positions.locationName: Santa Cruz, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Responsible for designing and creating web content under the direction of the User Experience Librarian. Create and update existing web content using HTML and CSS in a Bootstrap framework and create new functions using JavaScript or jQuery. Review the library SiteImprove reports to understand library website accessibility issues and work with the User Experience Librarian to make web content accessible.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · JavaScript · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Computer Science

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description:
Current working on a funded project: Camino
Camino is a 2D side-scrolling stealth game. I work with a co-engineer and people with different practices. I developed new core game mechanic within Unity using C#. I was assigned tasks to find and fix bugs with the game. The bugs varies from quality of life bugs to game-breaking bugs.

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description:
"Don't Walk Alone" Game Programmer
Created Don't Walk Alone, a 2D platformer/walking simulator with dialogue-based combat that conveys themes of resilience and empowerment to encourage the player to defeat misogyny & street harassment through wit, sass, and clap backs. As the lead programmer, I collaborated with the artist, game designer, and game narrative designers to make sure everything is working together seamlessly. I built the core mechanics, UI, and enemies using the Unity engine.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Led the development of a new feature in Excel, creating a demo-able feature by the end of 12 weeks
Applied engineering principles to solve complex problems
Actively integrated feedback and best practices to enhance technical solutions

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description: Gain experience in product management role and software engineering role. Gain hands-on experience with various tools and programming languages in software development. Collaborated with two other interns and learned about the development phase of a feature.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · C++ · Software Development · Teamwork

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description: I collaborated with another engineer to write functional code for their online game experiment. I made contributions to the development of the UI of the lab’s game using HTML, CSS, and Python. I employed collaborative skills to work with experts in the economics field to realize their project objectives. I addressed bugs in the codebase and the game.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I assisted with the improvement of UX and UI on the LaunchDarkly website by adding new accessible features. I translated and revised JavaScript files to TypeScript. I created accessible UI features to be added to LaunchDarkly’s established Storybook. I developed the Command Bar using React with the collaboration of other engineers and designers.
